sizeConvention: GiB, explicitly confirmed by the user; matching historical experiments
sourcePolicy: Reuse verified retained source; restore separate new disks; no old snapshot deletion or mutation
snapshotPolicy: Preserve every snapshot, including new staging and backup snapshots, in separately owned retained resource groups
measurement: 5-second raw guest disk counters, full VACUUM and 3 healthy catch-up samples, continuous PostgreSQL logs and recovery-prefetch stats
graphs: Separate await/IOPS/throughput figures, linear axes, primary/replica DATA/WAL reads and writes
snapshotCopyCoordination: 50/100 repair uses new owned staging disk -> new-family incremental Copy snapshot; baseline resumes verified paired backup. All earlier attempts/snapshots preserved.
hydrationPolicy: Before measurement: explicit100percent on every measured Copy/CopyStart disk; live ARM audit across all owned node disks and retained snapshots must prove no active copy; exact pinned terminal failed snapshots remain preserved.
